data.gender_notes: Falahat is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root word 'falaaha', meaning to attain success or prosperity. This name holds great significance in Islamic culture, symbolizing the journey towards spiritual and material fulfillment. The name Falahat carries the meaning “Success, prosperity” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Falahat usually hope their child will grow to embody success, prosperity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
